name: Mercure Makassar Nexa Pettarani
short_description: A 174-room hotel on Jalan A.P. Pettarani in Makassar's government and commercial district, with Toraja-inspired design, a ballroom, and an outdoor pool.
ai_summary: Mercure Makassar Nexa Pettarani is a 174-room hotel on the busy Jalan A.P. Pettarani corridor, in the heart of Makassar's government and commercial district and about 30 minutes from Sultan Hasanuddin International Airport. The property is known for its Toraja-carved local design touches, a 500-person ballroom and meeting rooms geared toward business and event guests, an outdoor pool, spa, and all-day dining at Losari Restaurant. Guest feedback is generally positive on location convenience, staff friendliness, and breakfast variety, but a recurring minority of reviews flag housekeeping lapses -- dirty bedsheets, tinted water, or dated bathroom fixtures -- worth checking on arrival.

core_facts.address: Jl. A.P. Pettarani No. 4, Gunung Sari, Rappocini, 90222 Makassar, South Sulawesi, Indonesia

pros: 174 rooms with a distinctive Toraja-carved local design theme
Central location on Jalan A.P. Pettarani near Mall Panakkukang, Mall Nipah, and Trans Studio Mall
500-person ballroom and modern meeting rooms suited to business events and weddings
Outdoor swimming pool, spa, and gym on site
Guests consistently praise staff friendliness and breakfast variety
cons: A recurring minority of reviews report housekeeping issues such as dirty bedsheets or dated bathroom fixtures
About 30 minutes from Sultan Hasanuddin International Airport, so not an airport-adjacent option
research_highlights: Toraja-carved exterior and local design cues set it apart from generic business hotels in Makassar
Central Jalan A.P. Pettarani location puts several major malls within easy reach
Breakfast spread, including traditional Indonesian offerings, draws repeated praise
research_watchouts: Multiple independent reviews describe cleanliness lapses -- stained linens, tinted water, or moldy fixtures -- pointing to inconsistent housekeeping standards rather than an isolated incident
Facilities are described by some guests as showing their age despite the hotel opening in 2019

faqs.question: How far is Mercure Makassar Nexa Pettarani from the airport?
faqs.answer: The hotel is roughly a 30-minute drive from Sultan Hasanuddin International Airport (UPG). It sits centrally on Jalan A.P. Pettarani instead, closer to Makassar's government and commercial district and shopping malls like Mall Panakkukang than to the airport.

faqs.question: What is the design theme of Mercure Makassar Nexa Pettarani?
faqs.answer: The hotel features a distinctive Toraja-carved exterior and local South Sulawesi design touches throughout its public spaces, blending Mercure's international four-star standard with authentic regional character -- a deliberate point of difference from more generic business hotels in the city.

faqs.question: Is Mercure Makassar Nexa Pettarani good for events or weddings?
faqs.answer: Yes -- it has a ballroom that holds up to 500 people plus modern meeting rooms, and guest content shows the venue regularly hosting weddings and corporate events, making it one of the more event-capable hotels in central Makassar.
